data.summary:
Data Governance and Data Stewardship professional with 7+ years of experience working on master data, CRM governance, data quality, and cross-functional data operations. Experienced in managing HCP and HCO datasets across Salesforce, Veeva CRM, and IQVIA platforms within Life Sciences environments.
Skilled in data quality management, data validation, root cause analysis, SLA governance, metadata management, and master data processes. Hands-on experience in resolving data inconsistencies, managing DCR lifecycle, maintaining affiliation hierarchies, and improving CRM data accuracy through governance controls and validation rules.
Worked closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Compliance, and business teams to support data governance initiatives, audit readiness, reporting accuracy, and operational decision-making. Familiar with data profiling, data reconciliation, KPI reporting, governance workflows, and enterprise data quality processes.

SKILLS
Data Governance & Quality: Data Governance, Data Stewardship, Master Data Management (MDM), Data Ownership, Data Quality Management, Data Governance Framework, Data Standards, Data Validation Rules, Metadata Management, Data Issue Management, Business Rules Management, Data Reconciliation, Data Integrity, Data Quality Monitoring, Data Profiling, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), SLA Governance, SOP Documentation

raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Data Governance Specialist Tech Mahindra Limited | Pune, India
Nov 2024 – Present
Serve as end-to-end Data Steward for HCP and HCO master datasets — maintaining affiliation hierarchies, resolving CI=2 (MMQ) conflicts, and ensuring ongoing data quality across 500,000+ commercial records to support accurate downstream reporting and business decisions.
Act as the primary subject-matter expert for CI=2 (MMQ) investigations, applying established governance rules and cross-system analysis to prevent erroneous record merges that would impact sales territory alignment and reporting integrity.
Govern complex affiliation and hierarchy scenarios by clearly delineating ownership relationships from functional affiliations, ensuring accurate organizational roll-ups and business-aligned reporting for Sales and Marketing teams.
Defined and operationalized data quality metrics covering accuracy, completeness, consistency, and CI=2 risk exposure — aligning measurement thresholds with agreed governance standards and business KPIs.
Conduct detailed cross-system validation between IQVIA reference data and Veeva CRM, resolving attribute-level discrepancies through evidence-based authority decisions and structured reconciliation processes.
Manage the full DCR (Data Change Request) lifecycle across Veeva CRM and Salesforce — overseeing intake prioritization, SLA tracking, root-cause analysis, and governance-aligned closure, while communicating risk status and resolution outcomes to senior stakeholders.
Technical Analyst MatrixMindz Financial Consultants, LLC | Remote
May 2024 – Aug 2024
Partnered with cross-functional business and IT teams to assess, design, and implement data-driven solutions supporting financial operations and CRM optimization.
Gathered and translated business data requirements into structured reporting frameworks, delivering actionable insights to senior leadership across revenue, expense, and profitability dimensions.
Developed and maintained daily, weekly, and monthly Power BI dashboards tracking key financial metrics — enabling trend identification across revenue streams and operational expenditure.
Led CRM data migration from Salesforce to Oracle NetSuite, ensuring data integrity throughout the transition by validating field mappings, resolving data conflicts, and documenting migration outcomes.
Provisioned remote computing environments on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and configured multi-layered firewall rules to enforce data security policies.
Managed domain migration from GoDaddy to Google Workspace, coordinating DNS configuration and minimizing operational disruption during transition.
Senior System Engineer – Data Governance Zensar Technologies Ltd | Pune, India
Jun 2019 – May 2024
Spearheaded data stewardship initiatives across 5+ business units — defining data ownership, establishing quality standards, and reducing data integrity incidents, supporting global teams across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Service.
Administered Salesforce data governance framework, enforcing data input standards, validation rules, and reporting protocols that improved overall CRM data accuracy by 60% over 18 months.
Leveraged Oracle SQL to query and analyze large-scale datasets, extracting business-critical insights and identifying data inconsistencies across cross-functional systems.

Identified systemic data quality issues and designed correction protocols — implementing automated clean-up processes and validation logic that significantly reduced error recurrence across master data records.
Authored and maintained comprehensive SOPs defining data ownership, stewardship responsibilities, access controls, and data accuracy standards, ensuring confidentiality and audit-readiness across all data domains.
Monitored and enforced SLA compliance for data governance requests — tracking resolution performance, implementing corrective workflows, and achieving consistent 95%+ SLA adherence quarter-over-quarter.
Utilized Salesforce CRM for data analysis and quality reporting across sales and customer service workflows, maintaining record- level accuracy for a user base spanning multiple global departments.
Modified and standardized database field configurations to support a global user base of 500+ across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Service, and Management functions.
Digital Marketing Executive The Imperial Tailoring Co. | Moscow, Russia
Sep 2017 – Dec 2018
Managed multi-platform social media campaigns and community engagement for a luxury fashion brand; designed marketing communications and email templates using SendPulse, supporting brand growth across digital channels.
